notes: GO Battle League format schedule and cup eligibility rules. Periods come from the Pokemon GO Fandom wiki season pages (which cite the official pokemongolive.com / pokemongo.com season announcements). Rotations switch at 1 p.m. local time (PT in early seasons) on the listed switch day; "end" is the last full day (switch day minus 1), so the switch day itself belongs to the next period. Season 0 = Pre-Season (Jan-Mar 2020); season 10.5 = the Interlude Season (Mar-Jun 2022). Format ids are PvPoke cup ids where they exist; a cup can run at several CPs (format "cp" is authoritative; cups[id].cp is the most common CP and cpVariants lists all seen). Base leagues great/ultra/master have no restrictions beyond the CP cap (Mega Evolutions are only legal in "mega" = "Mega Edition" weeks and cups whose rules allow them). Catch Cup rules (caught-during-season) cannot be checked from a team and PvPoke catch.json reflects only its latest edition. Include/exclude filters are copied verbatim from PvPoke (including filterType "evolution" and per-filter "leagues" scoping); archived PvPoke cup files reflect the most recent edition of a recurring cup, so older editions may have had slightly different ban lists. rulesText holds the wiki's human-readable rules. Weeks after the generated date (Season 28 remainder) are announced schedule, confidence medium. Championship-series cup id mapping (laic2025, euic2026, laic2027) was matched by type rules and is medium confidence.
